1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 g6 5..strategy: Supports the d4 knight, which the bishop on g7 attacks, and prepares to castle long. The aggressive set-up with pawn storm on the kingside is less effective here, since Black can answer it with ...d5 in a single move; White usually needs a more careful way to place the pieces.

Brings the last kingside piece out with pressure on e4 and gets ready to castle. Black keeps the d-pawn at home so that ...d5 stays a one-move strike, and White has to place the bishop and castle with care or be hit in the centre.
